title: The Long Work
description: A stone hall too wide to see across, where bare hands walk a procession slower than they want to, a detuned gong carries the question at half speed like a banner, a throat the size of the room answers from underneath, and one cold clock keeps count.

sections.development: the gong asks once, cold, over falling grit; the bow comes in under the fourth while it hangs
the hands alone, no gong: one pattern four times while the drum's room opens around it
the whole tune at last: the gong asks, the throat answers in its silence, the gong falls home and asks again while the throat hums
the throat alone over the bow: it opens its mouth without the hands and sinks a fourth, away from home
